title: 2.8.2 master / Arrow direction bug
symptom: In AAPS 2.8.2, the arrow direction on the main screen is often horizontal even when glucose is rising or falling, while the AAPS watchface and xDrip+ show a correct sloped arrow. This discrepancy is confusing and potentially dangerous.
cause: AAPS main screen uses the arrow direction provided by the BG source (e.g., xDrip+ or Dexcom app), which may be calculated differently (e.g., using a longer time interval or updated history values) than the arrow calculated by AAPS for the watchface, which uses a 5-minute delta. This can lead to different arrows between the phone and watchface.
fix: The issue was addressed in a commit (d43393e2af7f6133b267e04967e8fc2b70149d16) that likely changed the arrow calculation logic, but the exact fix is not described in the thread.
evidence_quote: AAPS shows arrow sent by source (calculated with G6 method), watchfaxe and other apps show calculated arrows (calculated with 5min Delta) => With my example AAPS will show the flat arrow sent by G6 APP (even if calculated short delta is +8 mg/dl) while all other app will calculate a 45° up arrow
